summary.text: Long Tran is a Democratic state representative from Georgia House District 80 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He owns Peachy Corners Cafe in Dunwoody and has worked as a network security consultant.

paragraphs.text: Tran lives in Dunwoody, Georgia, and attended Sinclair Community College and Ohio State University.
His career experience includes owning Peachy Corners Cafe and working as a network security consultant.
He has served on the Mayor of Dunwoody's Economic Recovery Advisory Board, on the governing boards of Chesnut Elementary School and Peachtree Middle School, and as chair of Cub Scout Pack 477.
Tran succeeded Matthew Wilson in District 80, assuming office on January 9, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Creative Arts & Entertainment Committee, the Natural Resources and Environment Committee and the Technology and Infrastructure Innovation Committee.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said his goals include lowering taxes, improving schools and making Georgia a safe home for working families.
